issue.title: Update-Skew Agent Auto-Restart
issue.description: When a live sase update breaks a running agent before its model turn, sase puts it back once, under the same name, exactly as `,x` plus an unmodified submit would, and tells the user what it did and why in one calm amber ↻ story. Every other update-shaped failure is surfaced with its reason and never silently swallowed. The refresh-path bug behind the 2026-10-09 incident can no longer recur.
